notes: Difficulty comes from correctly implementing a documented dequantize-2-layer-ReLU-argmax forward contract and making it generalize: the program must work on hidden models/vectors with non-unit scale/zero-point (where skipping dequant changes labels), break argmax ties to the lowest class, and reject ragged/mismatched/missing-field inputs with a failing exit and no output file. Exactness of the label output plus the required defensive error behavior make this a solid medium; there is no multi-stage pipeline, heavy tooling, or resource pressure, so it stays below hard.
